title: The Darkness of Hallowvale

overview.startPoint: Talk to Veliaf Hurtz in Burgh de Rott, who is in the cellar of Myreque Hideout.
otherReqs: Standard spells equipped or the ability to cast Spellbook Swap

extra.label: League auto-complete
extra.html: Unlocking Morytania will auto-complete the quest.

required.note: Items from the tool belt are not listed unless they do not work or are not automatically added.

items.html: 8 nails (any type except rune nails)
2 planks (regular, oak, teak, or mahogany)
1 law rune and 1 air rune for Telekinetic Grab (obtainable during the quest)

items.html: 1 charcoal (given to you during quest)
3 papyrus (given to you during quest)

blocks.html: As you will need Telekinetic Grab further into the quest, it is recommended to have the standard spellbook active.
Go to Burgh de Rott, then enter in the inn where you will climb over the broken down wall and climb down trapdoor in the northwest of inn.
blocks.text: Go to Burgh de Rott, then enter in the inn where you will climb over the broken down wall and climb down trapdoor in the northwest of inn.

blocks.html: Talk to Veliaf Hurtz in the Burgh de Rott pub basement.
blocks.text: Talk to Veliaf Hurtz in the Burgh de Rott pub basement.

options.text: Is there something I can do to help you?
[Accept Quest]
What is the Sanguinesti region?
How can I search for the Sanguinesti order of the Myreque?
Can you tell me about the Sanguinesti Myreque?
Tell me again how to get into the Sanguinesti region.
Ok, thanks.

substeps.html: Search the chest to the north for garlic if you do not have one.
substeps.text: Search the chest to the north for garlic if you do not have one.

blocks.html: Run directly south of the furnace until you find a boathouse.

blocks.html: Use a plank on the boat to fix it.
blocks.text: Use a plank on the boat to fix it.

blocks.html: South of the boat, use plank on the boat chute to fix it.
blocks.text: South of the boat, use plank on the boat chute to fix it.

blocks.html: Push the boat down the chute, then go down to the docks and board the boat. If a Vyrewatch stops you at any point, just activate Freedom and walk away.
blocks.text: Push the boat down the chute, then go down to the docks and board the boat. If a Vyrewatch stops you at any point, just activate Freedom and walk away.

substeps.text: Keybind may not work, recommended to click the ability on your action bar or in the Defence abilities tab.

blocks.html: Exit the boat by jumping onto the nearby rock, and continue north-west a short distance.
blocks.text: Exit the boat by jumping onto the nearby rock, and continue north-west a short distance.

blocks.html: Just before the shore, kick down the floor, and climb down it as shown on the image on the right.
blocks.text: Just before the shore, kick down the floor, and climb down it as shown on the image on the right.

blocks.html: Climb the wall rubble to the north and talk to a Meiyerditch citizen.
blocks.text: Climb the wall rubble to the north and talk to a Meiyerditch citizen.

options.text: (whisper) Do you know about the Myreque?
(whisper) I really need to meet the Myreque.
How can Old Man Ral help me?

blocks.html: North of the wall rubble, talk to Old Man Ral (Taskmaster icon on the map).
blocks.text: North of the wall rubble, talk to Old Man Ral (Taskmaster icon on the map).

options.text: Someone said you could help me.
Old Man Ral, the sage of Sanguinesti.

substeps.html: (Optional) If you want to reduce detection chance by the Vyrewatch, you can buy a set of Vyrewatch clothing from Trader Sven just south of Old Man Ral before continuing.
substeps.text: (Optional) If you want to reduce detection chance by the Vyrewatch, you can buy a set of Vyrewatch clothing from Trader Sven just south of Old Man Ral before continuing.

blocks.html: If you get snared by a vyre, you can still get away for free by using Freedom. Another option is to challenge them to a fight and then just running away without attacking.
Below are the steps to navigating Meiyerditch from the ladder south-west of Old Man Ral. You can click each step to highlight it to keep track of completed steps.
Changing "Entity Highlight Mode" in Settings->Accessibility->Visual Accessibility->High Contrast Mode to "Proximity" may help during the next steps.

blocks.caption: The final destination of this section of the quest. A room marked by a greenish-blue carped and wall-mounted sickle. This room is found against the mid-eastern wall of the city.

blocks.html: Open the door to the east and go northwest outside. Go past the house immediately north of the house you just left and into the house with a door on its east side.
